description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the four triggers the SKILL.md lists — a second agent reviewing before apply, independent parallel slices, competing candidate implementations, the explicit 'try it two ways' ask — plus a German variant. Near-misses share the 'second opinion' and 'parallel' vocabulary but belong elsewhere: external models outside the session (ai-council), a single isolated worktree (using-git-worktrees), and a devil's-advocate critique (adversarial-review). Counterexamples guard the one-liner fix the skill explicitly excludes and the 'agent' homonym in a sales context.

queries.q: have a second agent review this migration before we apply it
these six bug fixes are unrelated — split them across subagents and run them in parallel
try this caching layer two different ways and let a judge pick the better one
this touches the API, the queue and the frontend — implement it and have an independent judge check it before merging
Lass zwei Agents das unabhängig umsetzen und einen dritten die Ergebnisse vergleichen
ask GPT and another Claude outside this session whether the roadmap holds up
queries.note: a second opinion from external models, not implementer/judge subagents → ai-council

queries.q: try this refactor on the side without touching my current branch
queries.note: isolation for one line of work, no orchestration of agents → using-git-worktrees

queries.q: play devil's advocate on this architecture and be brutal
queries.note: a critique requested directly, no implementer to judge → adversarial-review

queries.q: fix the off-by-one in the pagination helper
queries.note: a one-liner fix — this skill's SKILL.md says a second agent's overhead exceeds the value

queries.q: assign the new leads to the sales agents by region
queries.note: 'agents' as people in a CRM, unrelated to subagents
